title: He Washed Dishes at Denny's. Now He Runs Nvidia
sources: Wikipedia, 'Jensen Huang': born 1963 in Tainan, Taiwan; in 1973, at nine, sent with his brother to the US and the Oneida Baptist Institute in Kentucky; co-founded Nvidia in April 1993 with Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem
Fortune, 'How Nvidia's billionaire CEO went from Denny's dishwasher...': at 15 he worked at Denny's as a dishwasher, busboy and waiter
NVIDIA Blog, 'Jensen Huang Returns to Denny's Where NVIDIA Launched a Trillion-Dollar Vision' (Sept 2023): Nvidia was planned in a booth at a Denny's in East San Jose; the booth now has a plaque
ABC News / Motley Fool, 23-24 Nov 2026: Huang resigned Nov 12 and was reinstated as CEO Nov 23, 11 days later; Nvidia worth trillions
